The Honda Civic Rebirth was first launched in Pakistan in September 2012 by Atlas Honda Pakistan. The 9th Generation Honda Civic received a facelift in late 2015 that introduced a series of minor cosmetic changes. It is offered with four variants Civic VTi 1.8 i-VTEC, Civic VTi Oriel 1.8 i-VTEC, Civic VTi Prosmatec 1.8 i-VTEC, Civic VTi Oriel Prosmatec 1.8 i-VTEC. Honda halted the production of Honda Civic 9th generation in 2016 with the arrival of the new generation. 

The Honda Civic (2012-2016) exterior features a familiar Honda design language. The front fascia features sleek narrow trapezium styled side swept headlights, a trapezium grille with a chrome accent, a trapezium air intake, and dual circular fog lights. The rear end houses trapezium styled side swept taillights. The facelift variant of the Honda Civic features a series of minor cosmetic revisions. The front end houses a new trapezium grill with a lower surround chrome accent and chrome door handles. All variants of the Honda Civic feature identical styling in every aspect.
